title: Moon 0.4.2 beta
notes:
[Download Moon for Mac](https://github.com/madetonight/moon-browser/releases/download/v0.4.2-beta/Moon-0.4.2-arm64.dmg)

One installer for Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. Open the DMG and drag Moon to Applications. The same DMG powers signed in-app updates.

- Meet Orbit: a native sidebar summary and activity window, connected optionally to the official local ActivityWatch engine and its full advanced workspace.
- Translate remains beside Downloads and Orbit, with a readable glass footer and responsive rows at narrow sidebar widths.
- Symmetric sidebar padding and smoother reveal behavior. What's New contains only the latest release.
- Moon tracking starts off; private tabs are excluded. Native records keep website names and hourly totals locally. Connecting ActivityWatch shares sanitized origins only when tracking is enabled.
- ActivityWatch is installed separately. Mac-wide watchers, plugins, sync and AI services require their own setup and permissions. See the [Orbit guide and coverage limits](https://github.com/madetonight/moon-browser/blob/main/Docs/ORBIT.md).

Installed Moon is approximately 11.3 MB; download approximately 5.1 MB. Personal browser profiles, logins, browsing records and test data are not included.

This beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. Connected installations can use Settings → About → Check now. GitHub's automatic source-code links contain source, not additional app installers.
